api: proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V4; proc_listchildpids recursively includes owned runtime/client/proxy descendants

cpu: raw rusage counters calibrated against CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID; observed Mach ticks converted with mach_timebase_info 125/3 on this M4
scope: all benchmark-owned descendants and observer, including controller/caffeinate overhead; live helper presence and PID start identity checked during idle

calibration_validation: CPU scale and recursive child discovery checked with own processes; complete one-VM build/service/allocate-touch-free flow passed on both adapters
cadence_validation: Four complete 60-second windows (post-build and controlled recovery, both adapters), 240 samples each; absolute monotonic deadlines avoid accumulated wake coalescing. Failed prior attempt retained separately.
